# unifi_switch_stacks (Data Source)

Lists switch stacks on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List switch stacks on the site via the Official API.
data "unifi_switch_stacks" "all" {}

# Only the stacks that contain a given unit, filtered server-side.
data "unifi_switch_stacks" "with_unit" {
  filter = "units.macAddress.eq('aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01')"
}

output "stack_device_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.unifi_switch_stacks.all.stacks : s.device_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing switch stacks. Stacks can be filtered by unit with `units.id` and `units.macAddress` (the former `members.deviceId` property was removed in controller 10.6.109).
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `stacks` (Attributes List) The switch stacks defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The UUID of the device that represents the stack as a whole. Null when the controller does not report it (controllers before 10.6.109).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the switch stack.
- `json` (String) The full switch stack record, including units and nested lags, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the switch stack entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The switch stack name.
- `units` (Attributes List) The physical switches (units) that make up the stack. Requires a controller running 10.6.109 or later; older controllers report no units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--units))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks--units"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.units`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The unit id within the stack (referenced by `unit_id` on switch-stack LAG members).
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the unit.
- `order` (Number) The position of the unit in the stack. Null when not reported.
- `role` (String) The unit role: `ACTIVE_CONTROLLER`, `BACKUP_CONTROLLER` or `MEMBER`. Null when not reported.
